errata.now: Version 2.3 (#1765) replaces the ledger with a census of all sixty-six catalogued additions, each scored under both accounts, and states the comparative conclusion: the earlier version Josephus describes is by far the more plausible and coherent explanation. Meshcherskii's no. 20 stands at War 2.266; the priests' debate is unnumbered in Meshcherskii. The census is Appendix IV.
errata.reason: At the author's word, 2026-11-12: 'lets do the full census … at each point and in sum whether differences are better explained by josephus' account of an earlier version or by the consensus account of medieval interpolations.'
